slices.focus: Maya drags Eric to a library family movie night showing an old baseball movie, which rekindles his comfort-watch habit; baseball movies become his default evening decompression after Maya's bedtime, replacing the indecisive scrolling pattern.
slices.summary: A cold January library movie night with Maya reconnects Eric to baseball movies as a repeatable, low-friction evening decompression ritual that tolerates interruption and requires minimal decision-making when tired.
